description: SAMPLE. Every Dataverse environment the scripts may talk to, and what each may receive. No secrets here, ever: authentication is the operator's own sign-in (az login / pac auth) or, in CI, a federated credential. Scripts refuse to run while tenantId is the placeholder. Per-developer environments go in environments.local.json (gitignored), which is merged on top by id. kind decides what a script may do: development takes unmanaged changes (schema, roles, exports); build is a clean environment that only ever holds the product's own solutions and makes the managed release; test and production take managed solutions only. requireApproval: imports need the owner's explicit go for this run (locally -ProductionGo, in CI the GitHub environment's required reviewers).
